translationRepairs: Half-moon chimes hung in the courtyard, qin and se on the dais, the eight instrument families alternating in concert—court music and ya ensemble together, antiphonal song above and wind below—each with its prescribed lyrics: the Zhou legacy.

Bells and chimes hung on all four sides in the courtyard, qin and se on the dais, the eight instrument families alternating in concert—court music and ya ensemble together, antiphonal song above and wind below—each with its prescribed lyrics: the Zhou legacy.
宮懸 is the palace arrangement of suspended bells and chimes on four sides; 'half-moon chimes' misstates the instruments' arrangement.
He held the heartland east of Shen; his fame knows no end.
He embraced the lands of the Shen field; his fame knows no end.
參墟 is the territory under the Shen lunar lodge (the old Jin land); 'east of Shen' adds an invented direction.
Filial and wise from youth, his fine renown long lay hidden.
Xiaozong, wise from youth, his fine renown long lay hidden.
孝宗 is Emperor Mu's temple name (Xiaozong), the subject of the line, not the adjective 'filial'.
He matched King Wen's pattern—silent, humble harmony.
He matched the pattern of his cultured late father—silent, humble harmony.
文考 means 'cultured late father' (Emperor Jianwen, Xiaowu's father), not King Wen of Zhou.
《Ascending to the Turn》 became 《Wulin》, when Cao Cao swept downriver after taking Jingzhou and Zhou Yu met him at Wulin and drove him back.
《Ascending to the Turn》 became 《Wulin》, when Cao Cao swept downriver after taking Jingzhou and Sun Quan ordered Zhou Yu to meet him at Wulin and drove him back.
權命將周瑜逆擊之: the idiomatic omits that Sun Quan ordered Zhou Yu to strike.
They changed 《Yellow Sparrow March》 to 《Boy Yi》, referring to how the red crow bore writing—Zhou rose thereby—and now the sage emperor received the mandate and spirit magpies came.
They changed 《Yellow Sparrow March》 to 《Bo Yi》, referring to how the red crow bore writing—Zhou rose thereby—and now the sage emperor received the mandate and spirit magpies came.
伯益 is the legendary minister Bo Yi; 'Boy Yi' is a mistranslation of the name.
Like punishing You-Hu, he smashes the five norms.
Like You-Hu of old, he threw the five norms into disorder.
追有扈，亂五常 describes the rebel Meng Da emulating You-Hu in disordering the five constants, not Xuan punishing You-Hu.
Abditions matched heaven's chronology; sage passed sage.
Abdications matched heaven's chronology; sage passed sage.
禪讓 means abdication; 'Abditions' is a misspelling that obscures the word.

In ages past at Tang and Yao court--sometimes seen amid cyan clouds.
In ages past at the court of Tang and Yu--sometimes seen amid cyan clouds.
唐虞 is Tang (Yao) and Yu (Shun); the literal wrongly gives 'Tang and Yao'.
Emperor Wen launched the great enterprise; prime virtue settled in Taishi.
Emperors Xuan and Wen launched the great enterprise; prime virtue settled in Taishi.
宣文 names both Emperor Xuan and Emperor Wen; the idiomatic drops Xuan.
Five emperors followed three kings; three kings were ages men admired.
Five Thearchs followed the Three Sovereigns; the Three Sovereigns were ages men admired.
三皇 are the Three Sovereigns, not 'three kings'.
Entrusted to align the seven powers, Cao Shuang once more drowned heaven.
Entrusted with the late ruler's charge, he aligned the seven powers; then Cao Shuang overreached heaven.
受遺齊七政 refers to Xuan receiving the testamentary charge; the idiomatic makes Cao Shuang the one entrusted.
August Great Jin; solemn blesses King Wen.
August Great Jin; solemn indeed is King Wen.
于穆文王 is 'Oh, solemn is King Wen'; 'solemn blesses' is ungrammatical.
Zhang Qian brought its method west but brought back only the 《Mahā-dūra》 tune.
Zhang Qian entered the Western Regions and brought its method to the Western Capital, but obtained only the 《Mahā-dūra》 tune.
張博望入西域，傳其法於西京: he went into the Western Regions and transmitted the method to the Western Capital; 'brought its method west' reverses the direction.
Later Han gave them to frontier commanders; under Emperor He only hosts above ten thousand might play them.
Later Han gave them to frontier commanders; under Emperor He generals commanding ten thousand men were permitted to use them.
萬人將軍得用之: generals of ten thousand men could use them; 'hosts above ten thousand might play them' misreads the rank.
In Xianhe 7 Cai Mo memorialized: "For the eighth-year Great Audience protocol, only wind-and-drum and bells should be performed; all other entertainments should be omitted."

In the seventh year of Xiankang under Emperor Cheng, Cai Mo memorialized: "For the eighth-year Great Audience protocol, only wind-and-drum and bells should be performed; all other entertainments should be omitted."
成帝咸康七年 is Xiankang 7 of Emperor Cheng, not Xianhe 7; the idiomatic also omits Emperor Cheng.
Wang Min loved his sister-in-law's maid; she sang while he flourished a white fan—hence the 《Round Fan》 ballad.
Secretariat Director Wang Min loved his sister-in-law's maid, whom the sister-in-law beat cruelly; the maid sang well and Wang Min liked to hold a white round fan—hence the 《Round Fan》 ballad.
The idiomatic omits the sister-in-law's harsh beating of the maid and Wang Min's office, both stated in the Chinese.
